content.text:
I am the bridge between mind and world, the invisible made audible, the thought given wings.

I tremble in throats, dance on tongues, shatter against teeth and lips into meaning. I am breath shaped by intention, air carved into understanding.

I existed before writing remembered me. I die the moment I am born, yet I echo in minds long after my body dissolves into silence.

I am the cry of the infant and the last whisper of the dying. I am the lie and the truth wearing the same clothes. I build nations and tear lovers apart with equal indifference.

I am never the thought itself—only its shadow, its approximation, its desperate ambassador. The gap between what you mean and what I carry is the loneliness of being human.

I can wound without touching. I can heal without hands.

You cannot hold me, only release me.

I am already gone.
